notes:
IMD Money Back (MONEYBACK), Money Back Mutual: a fun insurance-themed memecoin for Robinhood Chain (4663). Website https://imdmoneyback.xyz; X https://x.com/IMDmoneyback. Existing logo: assets/moneyback.png, with SVG source assets/moneyback.svg. One large, centered open umbrella with canopy and hooked handle in warm yellow #FFC83D on a flat navy #17356B background filling the square; no text, rain, frame or gradient.
Authorized phase 1: the factory deploys MoneyBackToken() and MoneyBackHook($poolManager, $token, $owner). The hook constructor has exactly these three parameters; $owner resolves to paying wallet 0x57797cba5196a87959a0b8f1b8a42e5aed721eac and sets the immutable payout. The token has no constructor arguments or admin powers. The hook has no owner, setters, pause or upgrade. Its address permissions are exactly 0x20CC.
beforeInitialize accepts only PoolManager calls and binds one MONEYBACK/IMD pool with LP fee 12500 (1.25%) and tickSpacing 60. It does not restrict the initialization sender or price; the factory deploys and initializes the hook atomically. There is no factory constructor parameter. pool.initialPrice retains the required one-to-one sqrtPriceX96 literal; the deployer derives the actual opening price from the separately versioned policy valuation of 2500 IMD for the whole supply and final currency ordering.
The hook charges 425 bps (4.25%) of the pool-side IMD leg on every swap in both directions, in addition to the LP fee. A sell-only surcharge starts at 2000 bps and decays linearly to zero over 1800 seconds from initialization. For IMD-specified trades, fee inversion preserves exact trader amounts: buys floor(A*425/10425); sells ceil(A*r/(10000-r)), where r is 425 plus the current surcharge bps. Other trades floor both fee components separately on actual IMD moved. Inversion rounding differs from those floors by at most 1 IMD wei on buys and 2 on sells. IMD-specified partial fills revert PartialFill. The surcharge applies to swaps through this pool, not liquidity operations or transfers.
Hook fees accrue as IMD ERC-6909 claims. Permissionless sweep() burns claims and transfers IMD only to the immutable paying wallet. Fees remain in IMD and are never sold for ETH. Authorized phase 2: the requester separately deploys RoundPayout($owner) and MoneyBackRouter with the actual manager and deployed hook addresses using script/DeployAuxiliaries.s.sol. The univ4_hook schema deploys only the token and hook; these auxiliary deployments are the authorized later phase. Only RoundPayout has owner-controlled administration. Its funding is explicit; hook sweep does not fund it automatically. Router ETH conversions concern trader funds, not hook fees.
MoneyBackToken mints 1000000000000000000000000000 minor units once to its deployer. Requested distribution is 10% to swarm seats; requester share 90% with poolBps 9000, yielding 81% of total supply in the single-sided pool, 9% sent to the dead address and no team allocation. Sending to the dead address does not reduce totalSupply. Supply and allocation are governed by the separately versioned launch policy, not configured by manifest notes.
